homepage.mainText: Welcome to Our Practice Bright Smiles Family Dentistry Welcome to Bright Smiles Family Dentistry, your dental home for comprehensive dental care in a comfortable environment. We are dedicated to providing the highest quality care using the latest technology and state-of-the-art equipment. Our caring team is passionate about helping you achieve the smile of your dreams. We treat you like family and we are committed to excellence in everything we do. Look no further for all of your dental needs. We offer painless dentistry and we guarantee you will love your new smile. Dr. Smith is a cosmetic dentistry specialist and specializes in implant dentistry, sedation dentistry and family dentistry. We have been voted the best dentist in Fairview and we are the #1 choice for families. Our comprehensive restorative dentistry, periodontal therapy, endodontic treatment and prosthodontics utilize composite resin and address malocclusion, bruxism and caries with a personalized treatment plan to achieve optimal oral health and exceptional dental care. We accept all insurance plans. Call us today! Learn More Read More Click Here Our Services We provide general dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, Invisalign, teeth whitening, root canal therapy, dental crowns, dentures, veneers, tooth extraction and pediatric dentistry. Ask us about sedation dentistry. What Our Patients Say “Dr. Smith did my implants and veneers and they are perfect. I used to hate the dentist!” — Jennifer R. “Best dental office in Fairview. The whole staff is wonderful.” — Marcus T.

pages.mainText: About Us Dr. Smith and the caring team at Bright Smiles Family Dentistry are committed to excellence. We utilize the latest in dental technology in a relaxing environment. Dr. Smith is a cosmetic dentistry specialist who is passionate about creating beautiful smiles. Our friendly staff will exceed your expectations. We are dedicated to personalized care for the whole family. Call us at (555) 020-0456 or (555) 020-0999 to schedule.

pages.title: Bright Smiles Family Dentistry
pages.mainText: Our Services General Dentistry Comprehensive exams, prophylaxis, radiographs, fluoride varnish, sealants and composite resin fillings for the whole family. Cosmetic Dentistry Veneers, teeth whitening and smile makeovers. We guarantee results you will love and our whitening is permanent. Restorative Dentistry Crowns, bridges, dentures, dental implants and endodontic therapy (root canals). Periodontal Therapy Scaling and root planing for periodontal disease, and treatment for bruxism and TMJ. Pediatric Dentistry Gentle care for children of all ages. Sedation Dentistry Nitrous oxide and oral conscious sedation for anxious patients. Before and After Gallery
